This section contains proposed and reviewed decisions. Draft guidance should not be treated as approved policy by implication.

- [Minimum GeoEpi Project Standard](../start/minimum-standard.qmd) — proposed draft policy requiring review.
- [GeoEpi Practice Audit](geoepi-practice-audit.qmd) — internal-draft, informational repository audit.
- [Open Policy Decisions](open-policy-decisions.qmd) — unresolved questions requiring human approval.

A future standard should state its scope, rationale, owner, effective date, review cycle, exceptions process, and relationship to institutional or funder requirements.
